**DM-272 evidence: criterion → test map** (attempt at_01m7j98gf29jcdyxx651aap38h)

Criterion -> test (file › describe › it):
DM-180 c1 -> ticket/ScorecardTab.test.tsx › 'DM-180 c1: grade state, coverage, versions and contributions' › 'shows a final grade with coverage, policy version and each factor contribution', 'shows a %s grade as %s' (provisional/ungraded/in progress/failed), 'shows a missing component as carrying no weight, never as 0 points'; scorecard/scorecardFormat.test.ts › 'DM-180 c1: grade states', '...coverage and score text', '...baseline version'.
DM-180 c2 -> ScorecardTab.test.tsx › 'DM-180 c2: units, attribution and unavailable values' › 'shows usage and time with units and the run they are attributed to', 'reads values the core has no number for as unavailable, never 0', 'opens the attempt a row names and the evidence a component cites'; scorecardFormat.test.ts › 'DM-180 c2: units and unavailable values'; scoreReads.test.ts › 'DM-180 c2: ...grade cutoff'.
DM-180 c3 -> ScorecardTab.test.tsx › 'DM-180 c3: legacy and multi-attempt tickets...' › 'renders a legacy ticket ungraded...', 'lists every attempt of a multi-attempt ticket...'; › 'DM-180 c3: switching ticket or run never shows stale data' (holdNext getTicketGrade) ×2; scoreReads.test.ts › 'DM-180 c3: switching selection never shows the previous selection'.
DM-181 c1 -> epic/EpicScorecard.test.tsx › 'DM-181 c1…' › 'an active epic opens its live grade from the header…', 'a completed epic shows the immutable grade… and reads nothing live'.
DM-181 c2 -> epic/epicScorecardView.test.ts › 'DM-181 c2…' (4 tests); EpicScorecard.test.tsx › 'says the epic failed although every feature ticket was accepted, and opens a sprint…'.
DM-181 c3 -> epicScorecardView.test.ts › 'DM-181 c3…' › 'sums every attempt of every run…', 'counts the cancelled run's abandoned attempt…', 'never sums parallel elapsed time…'; EpicScorecard.test.tsx › 'counts the cancelled run's abandoned work…'.
DM-182 c1 -> checkpoint/ReportTabs.test.tsx › 'DM-182 c1…' (2); reportScorecardView.test.ts › 'DM-182 c1…' (3); ReportScorecard.test.tsx › 'DM-182 c1…' (historical, awaiting approval, live).
DM-182 c2 -> reportScorecardView.test.ts › 'DM-182 c2: sprint outcome status and resource totals', 'DM-182 c2: measurement coverage, grade factors and ticket drill-down'; ReportScorecard.test.tsx › 'DM-182 c2…' (3).
DM-182 c3 -> reportScorecardView.test.ts › 'DM-182 c3…' (2); ReportScorecard.test.tsx › 'keeps the approved snapshot and shows the reassessment beside it…', 'takes a new reading only when asked again'.
DM-183 c1 -> scorecard/feedbackForm.test.ts › 'c1: ticket view labels inheritance and missing feedback' (5), 'c1: sprint view says whether its one rating is shared', 'c1: a grade's S label is own, inherited or none'; FeedbackControls.test.tsx › 'c1: a rating recorded once per sprint or per ticket, never filled in' (4), 'c1: a rating kept through failures and ratings recorded meanwhile'; checkpoint/SprintFeedback.test.tsx › 'c1: …' (6).
DM-183 c2 -> feedbackForm.test.ts › 'c2: optional actual minutes with a floor of 1'; FeedbackControls.test.tsx › 'c2: rescue needs a reason and takes optional minutes' (6), 'c2: planned review or playtesting is a separate input, never a rescue' (4).
DM-183 c3 -> ticket/budgetForm.test.ts › 'c3: budget estimates with units and provenance', 'c3: strict minutes, basis choice and summaries', 'c3: versions show the one frozen at dispatch and later ones only as prospective'; BudgetFields.test.tsx › 'c3: token and time estimates with units and provenance', 'c3: entries kept through conflicts and moved drafts', 'c3: frozen at dispatch, later changes only prospective', 'c3: dispatch notes…'; core/services/drafts.personEstimate.test.ts (person-estimate refusal).
DM-187 c1 -> checkpoint/improvementView.test.ts › 'DM-187 c1: the measured result heads the chain', 'DM-187 c1: findings link to the experiments drawn from them'; ReportImprovement.test.tsx › 'DM-187 c1…' › 'reads the chain in order from the frozen grade', 'links a finding to its experiment and back, and opens cited evidence on its ticket', 'shows the resulting work of an experiment and where it is held', 'says a report from before scorecards has no findings, and reads none'.
DM-187 c2 -> improvementView.test.ts › 'DM-187 c2: plannerRequest asks for exactly the person's selection and edits', 'DM-187 c2: the preview shows criteria, dependencies and destination'; CorrectivePlanner.test.tsx › 'DM-187 c2: select, edit and preview before creating a draft' (3), 'DM-187 c4 (view): opening the report starts no work'.
DM-187 c3 -> improvementView.test.ts › 'DM-187 c3: …' (selectability, plannerRequest leaves out what no longer fits, fittingTarget, editStanding, createBlock/previewStanding, resultStands/resultView/shownNotice, plannerFailure); CorrectivePlanner.test.tsx › 'DM-187 c3: repeated clicks start one request', 'stale draft and stale report keep the person's work' (3), 'blocked prerequisites and blocked work'; ReportImprovement.test.tsx › 'DM-187 c3: unavailable evidence is recoverable' (3).
DM-188 c4 (view) -> ReportImprovement.test.tsx › 'DM-188 c4 (view): …' › 'shows the classification, target, baseline and measured after-result…', 'shows a failed guardrail as regressed… and missing data as insufficient evidence', 'falls back to the outcome carried on the report…'; retroView.test.ts › 'DM-188 c4 (view): experimentRow sets each result against the frozen baseline with its evidence' (3).
DM-191 c1 -> checkpoint/CrossRepoCorrection.test.tsx › 'DM-191 c1: the preview identifies the destination project and the new epic's ownership' › 'names the chosen checkout's project and exact folder…', 'works with a separate local Dark Mechanicus checkout…', 'works with the active repository as its own target, read as this folder'; crossRepoView.test.ts › 'DM-191 c1: …' (5+); correctionRoute.test.ts › 'DM-191 c1…' (2).
DM-191 c2 -> CrossRepoCorrection.test.tsx › 'DM-191 c2: an unavailable checkout keeps a recoverable pending proposal', 'an already-created correction shows the epic the target holds' (3), 'duplicate clicks create one epic' (held deferred, double click -> one create), 'a partial routing failure is recoverable' (2), 'refreshed target state' (2); crossRepoView.test.ts › 'DM-191 c2: …' (6 describes).
DM-191 c3 -> CrossRepoCorrection.test.tsx › 'DM-191 c3: opening or creating a proposal executes nothing…' › 'previews and creates through the broker only: no run, claim, save or approval is sent', 'tells the shell the target folder changed after Create and after Retry, with the target path'; crossRepoView.test.ts › 'DM-191 c3…'.
DM-267 c1 -> sidebar/SidebarFooter.test.tsx › 'DM-267 c1: the Metrics link below the MCP line' (4); app/chooseView.test.ts › 'DM-267 c1: the Metrics dashboard view' (4).
DM-267 c2 -> metrics/metricsView.test.ts › 'unknown values read unavailable, never 0', 'grades and coverage', 'sprint trend entries'; MetricsDashboard.test.tsx › 'DM-267 c2: the summary renders as get_metrics_summary gives it', 'DM-267 c2: empty and nothing-to-grade states', 'DM-267 c2: tables, trend and read states'.
DM-267 c3 -> MetricsDashboard.test.tsx › 'DM-267 c3: epic rows and gaps open the matching Scorecard' (4); metrics/metricsNavigation.test.ts › 'DM-267 c3: leaving and reopening the dashboard', 'DM-267 c3: drill-down lands on the Scorecard tab'; app/selection.test.ts › 'DM-267 c3: the Metrics dashboard selection persists and restores' (3).
